query:
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM external_completions
    WHERE external_credit_target_id = $1
      AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR external_credit_target_code_id = $2)
  )
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM credit_registrations
    WHERE external_credit_target_id = $1
      AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR external_credit_target_code_id = $2)
  ) AS "exists!"
